items.title: Price increase for 'Kabel 250' tariff takes effect
items.quote: zum 01.02.2027 erhöhen wir den Preis Ihres Tarifs „Kabel 250“ um 3,00 € auf 37,99 € im Monat (bisher 34,99 €).
items.computation: The letter states the new price of 37,99 € (up from 34,99 €) becomes effective on 01.02.2027. This is a stated calendar date, taken as written.

items.title: Last day to exercise special free termination right due to price increase
items.quote: Sie dürfen den Vertrag deshalb innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens kostenlos und ohne Kündigungsfrist beenden, frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung.
items.computation: This is a private-law letter (not an administrative act), so the statutory 3-day delivery fiction of §41 VwVfG/§122 AO/§37 SGB X does not apply; instead §130 BGB governs, i.e. the period starts on the day the letter actually reaches the recipient. The letter is dated Wednesday 18.11.2026; no explicit delivery date is stated, so, absent other evidence, I assume ordinary domestic post delivery within roughly 1-2 business days, i.e. receipt on or about Friday 20.11.2026 (this assumption is uncertain - see warnings). Starting the three-month period on the day after receipt per §187 Abs. 1 BGB (the receipt day, 20.11., does not count), the period ends, per §188 Abs. 2/3 BGB, on the day in the third following month that numerically corresponds to the start day, i.e. 20.02.2027. 20.02.2027 falls on a Saturday; under §193 BGB a deadline for a declaration (Willenserklärung) that falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next business day, which is Monday 22.02.2027 (no NRW public holiday on that date). The termination becomes effective earliest at the price-increase date (01.02.2027), but the notice to the provider must reach it by this deadline to qualify for the free special termination right.

warnings: The exact date the letter was actually received by the recipient is not stated; the three-month special termination deadline was computed assuming receipt around 20.11.2026 (a few days after the 18.11.2026 letter date) because the actual postal delivery date is unknown — please check when the letter actually arrived and recompute if it differs.
No legal-remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) are present, consistent with this being a private commercial notice rather than an administrative decision.
